english.title: Wilfully obstruct an examiner carrying out inspection of permits / vehicles under section 6
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), wilfully obstructed an examiner, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), in the exercise of powers under section 6 of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018, in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(3) and (6) of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: For the purposes of this offence, an examiner means an examiner appointed under section 66A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 or Article 74 of the Road Traffic (Northern Ireland) Order 1995.
